O.outcome_detail: perceived usefulness and limitations of AI tools for dyslexic learners

cells.quote: "The retrieved subgraphs from the KG suggests that dyslexic learners perceive existing AI tools as useful but still limited, indicating scope for further AI development in this area."
cells.note: The quoted sentence is from the wiki entry rather than the supplied study text. It reports an author interpretation from retrieved KG subgraphs, not a tested treatment-comparison; no effect size or test statistic is printed.

O.outcome_detail: overlap and structural correspondence among knowledge points

result.effect: 58 KPs in the KG backbone; 29 overlapped with the Mokken scale

cells.quote: The KG backbone structure consisted of 58 KPs, with 29 KPs overlapping with the Mokken scale.
cells.note: This is a comparison of analytic representations rather than an instructional treatment contrast.

O.outcome_detail: association between SEL and average GPA

cells.quote: SEL estimated by the 3PLM correlated significantly with the high-ability range of average Grade-Point Average (p < 0.05).
cells.note: The study reports significance but does not state whether the correlation was positive or negative.

O.outcome_detail: hierarchical relationships and correlations among knowledge points

cells.quote: Visual analysis of the KG backbone structure revealed that the difficulty level of KPs in the IRT could not replace their position parameters in the KG.
cells.note: This is a methodological comparison of two representations rather than a manipulated instructional treatment.

O.outcome_detail: differential item and test functioning in the SEL measure

cells.quote: We identified 50 KPs to create the Mokken scale, which exhibited high reliability (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.9675) with no gender bias at the overall or at each item level (p > 0.05).
cells.note: The non-significant result is coded ns because no equivalence test or adequate-power claim is reported.
